scripts.cloudflare:web:deploy: npx wrangler --cwd ./apps/website deploy && npx wrangler --cwd ./apps/website d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .output/server/wrangler.json
scripts.cloudflare:web:deploy-preview: npx wrangler --cwd ./apps/website d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .output/server/wrangler.json && npx wrangler --cwd ./apps/website preview --config .output/server/wrangler.json --name "${CLOUDFLARE_PREVIEW_NAME:?CLOUDFLARE_PREVIEW_NAME env var is required}" --json > "${PREVIEW_OUTPUT_FILE:?PREVIEW_OUTPUT_FILE env var is required}"
